ayahs.1: We sent it—the Qur'an—down on the Night of Decree, Laylat al-Qadr—
ayahs.2: And what will explain to you what the Night of Decree is?
ayahs.3: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months—sincere worship that night outweighs decades of ordinary time.
ayahs.4: On it the angels and the Spirit—Jibril—descend by their Lord's permission with every decreed matter—
ayahs.5: Peace it is until the breaking of dawn—mercy without turmoil until morning comes.
